name: Hebron/Al-Khalil Old Town
description: The Old Town of Hebron/Al-Khalil in the West Bank grew around the Ibrahimi Mosque, also known as the Tomb of the Patriarchs, a compound first built in the 1st century AD. Jews, Christians and Muslims all revere it as the burial place of Abraham and his family. Visitors find a Mamluk-era maze of limestone lanes and quarters, with Ottoman upper floors added to the houses. The site is listed as World Heritage in Danger.
